questions.question: Which god is known as the god of thunder in Norse mythology?
questions.explanation: Thor is known in Norse mythology for his strength and his hammer Mjölnir, which generates lightning and thunder. He is counted among the chief gods and is often depicted as a protector of humans.

questions.question: What financial support do children in a blended family typically receive?
Which of these foods is known for causing intolerance in many people?
questions.explanation: Milk contains lactose, a sugar that many people cannot digest due to an enzyme deficiency. This intolerance leads to symptoms such as bloating and stomach pain. In contrast, rice, potatoes, and carrots are generally well tolerated.

questions.question: Which mountain range has higher relief energy due to its location in a tropical climate?
questions.explanation: The Himalayas are characterized by high relief energy, which is intensified by strong erosion and tectonic activities in a humid, tropical climate. In comparison, the other mentioned mountain ranges, such as the Alps or the Rocky Mountains, have different climatic conditions that influence relief formation.

questions.question: What event typically marks the beginning of the modern era?
choices: A: The invention of the printing press by Johannes Gutenberg
B: The fall of the Western Roman Empire
C: The founding of the Holy Roman Empire
D: The discovery of America by Christopher Columbus
questions.explanation: The discovery of America by Christopher Columbus in 1492 is often considered the beginning of the modern era, as it initiated European expansion into the New World. This era is marked by significant changes in society, culture, and politics in Europe.

questions.question: Which author is known for his work 'The Trial', which deals with themes of guilt and power?
questions.explanation: 'The Trial' is a novel-like text by Franz Kafka, published posthumously. The work is considered one of the most significant in modern literature and addresses the absurdity and powerlessness of the individual in the face of an opaque bureaucracy.

questions.question: Which animal primarily feeds on plants?
questions.explanation: Elephants are herbivores and mainly feed on grass, leaves, and tree bark. In contrast, wolves are carnivores, while owls and sharks also primarily consume animal food.

questions.question: Who is the current President of the United States?
Which player is known for his time with the Chicago Bulls and won a total of six NBA championships in the 1990s?
questions.explanation: Michael Jordan is considered one of the greatest basketball players of all time. His successes with the Chicago Bulls in the 1990s, including six NBA championships, have made him a sports icon.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The cat chased the mouse', what is the subject?
questions.explanation: The subject of a sentence is the noun or pronoun that performs the action. In this case, 'The cat' is performing the action of chasing, making it the subject.

questions.question: Which popular AI application is commonly used for generating text and dialogues?
questions.explanation: ChatGPT is an AI-powered text generation model used for creating dialogues and content. In contrast, Photoshop is an image editing program, AutoCAD is used for technical drawing, and Excel is a spreadsheet software. While these programs have their own applications, they are not AI applications for text generation.

What describes the concept of inertia in classical mechanics?
choices: A: A body can never change its direction of motion.
B: A body remains at rest or moves at a constant velocity unless an external force acts on it.
C: The velocity of a body always increases when a force acts on it.
D: Inertia is the ability of a body to maintain its temperature.
questions.explanation: The concept of inertia states that a body will remain at rest or in motion unless acted upon by external forces. This is a fundamental assumption of classical mechanics formulated by Newton.
